matchedActions.description:
List of {@link MergeOp} that store merge actions
Each contains condition, action, and optional data field

title:
MergeActions provides methods to define and execute merge actions based on specified conditions.
 There are three cases, each could followed by some actions to update the table:
 1. When a source row matches a target table row based on the merge condition (whenMatched clauses), see {@link MergeActions.WhenMatched} for available actions.
 2. When a source row does not match any target row based on the merge condition (whenNotMatched clauses), see {@link MergeActions.WhenNotMatched} for available actions.
 3. When a target row does not match any rows in the source table based on the merge condition (whenNotMatchedBySource clauses), see {@link MergeActions.WhenNotMatchedBySource} for available actions.
 Each clause can have an optional condition and there maybe multiple clauses for each case. Only if the condition is met that the action will be executed.
 Examples:
```py
 df.write_table(table, mode="merge", on=["id", "timestamp"], writer=c3.MergeActions.whenMatched().update({'col1': 's.col1 + t.col1'}).whenNotMatched().insertAll())
```
name: MergeActions
